description:
Abnormal AI for Government (Abnormal Gov) is a cloud-native, API-based offering that provides holistic email security for cloud email platforms – Microsoft365 and Google Workspace, against the full spectrum of email attacks including advanced phishing, fraud, account compromise, supply chain compromise, user-reporting phishing, and more.
The platform connects via API to analyze thousands of signals from multiple data sets and precisely baseline known behavior of every employee within an organization and every vendor within the supply chain. Autonomous AI models enable Abnormal Gov to detect anomalous activity and stop never-before-seen attacks quickly and accurately. The platform also serves as an AI Security Co-worker by fully automating the triage and remediation of user-reported emails. AI models judge user-reported emails as safe, spam, or malicious and automatically remediate malicious emails across all affected users using AI, eliminating any manual intervention by security analysts. Additionally, AI models automatically learn the behavioral preferences of every employee through their folder movements of graymail and autonomously declutter inboxes from unwanted mail thereby boosting employee productivity.

Abnormal Gov’s cloud email security product suite includes Inbound Email Security, Email Account Takeover Protection, AI Security Mailbox, Email Security Posture Management, and Email Productivity. The platform leverages a multi-tenant government cloud computing environment and is available for public, federal, state, local, and tribal governments.

description:
Archive360 provides a modern archive and governance platform to address the challenge of a growing number of digital communications channels, legal and regulatory record retention, data privacy and security requirements. Compliantly collecting, retaining, and managing growing volumes of data from multiple channels in a timely manner is increasingly important to department and agency missions, and difficult without the proper tools. Archive360’s platform helps manage data consistent with digital record keeping requirements, such as the Federal Records Act, NARA Records Management Rules, and OMB directives on transition to electronic records.  
Archive360’s solutions enable adoption of the federal government’s Cloud First mandates, Executive Orders as to cloud optimization, and OMB’s directives including M-23-07.  Archive360’s solutions have been successfully deployed and trusted by public sector agencies globally in the U.S., U.K., Canada, and Australia, including numerous components of U.S. security, civilian intelligence, educational, veterans’ agencies as well as individual US States.
Archive360’s digital communications governance and archiving solution brings together data from common channels and legacy archives into a petabyte-scale platform that: 
•        Ensures that digital communications are captured, governed, and readily accessible to authorized stakeholders
•        Provides extensive retention and disposition capabilities supporting government and agency records management requirements
•        Enables data classification across communication and data channels for granular governance controls
•        Supports file and data archiving use cases
•        Provides secure, scalable eDiscovery and FOIA-search capabilities through an intuitive user interface
•        Provides case management, tagging and annotation capabilities for investigations and review and production of data 
•        Delivers cross-system visibility and control over data processing, retention, disposition and legal holds 
•        Ensures data authenticity and chain of custody with a complete audit trail for actions (system and user) within the platform 
•        Cloud-native platform that provides high-levels of data durability, resiliency, and immutability where required
•        Zero trust security model, which requires specific entitlement grants to access any data. The platform incorporates an entitlement engine, which allows for granular access controls, including restrictions based on role, class of data, functionality
•        Encryption of all data in motion and at rest, with the option for agency managed encryption keys

Security and scalability are paramount for government departments and agencies to achieve their data governance mission.  Archive360 deploys each agency in a dedicated SaaS environment, deployed to their own tenant. As a result, each department, agency or organizational unit has completely segregated data, administrative access, entitlements, and the ability to integrate into their security protocols. 

Archive360 is deployed as a cloud-native, microservices architecture. Archive360 can tailor the deployment to specific mission workloads and requirements. This deployment model mitigates data migration or exit risk at the end of a term, since the tenant can be turned over to the department or agency with the resident data.

Throughout the platform, Archive360 maintains an extensive event audit history, supporting a complete chain of custody. This includes data processing, access, changes to configurations and controls, search, disposition, or export, all at an object level. This provides rapid traceability for audit and response purposes, and defensibility of authorized activities. 
Supported digital communication channels include:
•        SMTP and Journal Based Email
•        Microsoft M365 and Exchange
•        Microsoft Teams
•        Google Workspace
•        SMS and Mobile Data
•        FileShare Data
•        Legacy Email Archives

description:
Keyfactor for Government is delivered as a SaaS offering using a multi-tenant Government Community cloud computing environment. The Keyfactor for Government cloud service offering provides a Certificate Lifecycle Automation and Management (CLAaaS) solution for US Federal Departments and Agencies to manage digital certificate lifecycle across their enterprise. 

Keyfactor for Government enables Certificate Lifecycle Automation and Management through our Keyfactor Command web-based console, which simplifies and organizes certificate inventory, alerting and reporting, issuance, and automation. Our solution provides visibility and management of all public and private certificates in use across the customer’s on-premise and cloud environments and enables workflow automations to prevent outages due to expired certificates. 

Keyfactor for Government allows you to: 
 - Securely connect to your on-premise Microsoft or EJBCA Certificate Authority and/or to public CAs from Entrust, DigiCert, or Sectigo. 
 - Inventory certificates across your enterprise and/or cloud environments. 
 - Automate the issuance and deployment of certificates

description:
IQ FedCloud is delivered as a SaaS offering using a multi-tenant Government-Only Cloud computing environment. It is available to federal, state, local, and tribal governments.

Intranet Quorum (IQ) and the FedRAMP authorized implementation, IQ FedCloud, is a SaaS application offering Customer Relationship Management (CRM), correspondence management, Casework, business process management (BPM) and workflow. IQ is commonly used to support both constituent and agency needs ranging from simple task management to complex Freedom of Information (FOIA) requests. IQ’s core modules include Contacts, Messages, Outreach, Services, Library, and Events which combine to help agencies and elected officials to keep a complete history of their communications and manage their suspense tracking needs. IQ streamlines document management processes including approval for electronic signature and resolution. Robust reporting capabilities enhance data analytics for executive awareness and review. IQ lets users securely exchange record data with other agencies with the unique IQ2IQ capability. IQ addresses a wide range of executive management needs including grants, investigations, Boards and Commissions, communications, and records management and retention.  A no code solution, IQ is fully configurable without custom development.

description:
The Trellix ESC GovCloud is a SaaS offering that provides advanced protections against modern sophisticated email attacks. ESC GovCloud consolidates advanced threat prevention with traditional Email Anti-Spam and Anti-Virus security to optimize spending, reduce false positives, and enable operational efficiencies through consolidation. ESC GovCloud can be deployed in line to analyze emails and quarantine threats for active protection, or as a passive monitor for 'bcc' type review of each email.

With no hardware or software to install, the ESC GovCloud is a particularly good fit for organizations seeking to move their infrastructure into the cloud. This eliminates the complexity of procuring, installing, and managing a physical infrastructure. ESC GovCloud provides organizations several unique capabilities, such as:

- Identifying previous targets of spear-phishing, impersonation, virus and spam emails
- Locating copies of the malicious email in target inboxes
- Finding out if the message is being forwarded to new targets
- Detection of advanced malicious URL threats
- The ESC Portal shows region- and industry-based malware trends, has customizable security policies, RBAC, and audit logging.

Organizations face an ever-increasing number of threats from email-based spam, viruses, and advanced threats. ESC GovCloud uses the signature-less Trellix Multi-vector Virtual Execution™ (MVX) engine to analyze every attachment and URL within emails to detect threats and stop advanced attacks in real-time. Today's advanced attacks use email as a primary delivery mechanism for malicious content. While some attacks use an attachment with embedded malicious code, it is common for cybercriminals to use a malicious link thereby blending attack tactics in the hopes of bypassing today's traditional defense silos. ESC GovCloud uses the cloud-based MVX engine to detonate email attachments against a cross-matrix of operating systems and applications, including multiple Web browsers and plug-ins like Adobe Reader and Flash. To block spear-phishing emails, ESC GovCloud analyzes every attachment using the MVX engine to accurately identify today's advanced attacks.

ESC GovCloud includes anti-virus and anti-spam engines and may also be paired with an organization's existing anti-virus and anti-spam email gateways.
